name: Villa Crespi
dinnerNote: Inner Spirit tasting menu, for the whole table (Italian Journey menu €290)
hotel: the Villa Crespi hotel by Lake Orta

menus.name: Inner Spirit tasting menu
menus.note: For the whole table; lunch or dinner; wine pairing from the wine list

menus.name: Italian Journey menu
menus.note: Can be ordered by some of the table, alongside the à la carte

dressCode: Smart casual. Men need trousers, a long-sleeved shirt or jumper, and closed shoes.
bookingOpens: Online on the restaurant's website or by phone; book well ahead. Closed on Mondays and Tuesdays, and for a winter break in January and a summer break in August.

bookingWindow.note: The calendar shows the current month and the two after it; hotel guests can book further ahead.

waitlist: If your date is full, join the waiting list; the reservations team phones or emails if a table comes free.
cancellation: Your card is authorised for the cost of the table when you book, and released in full if you cancel within the terms of the booking conditions.
